operation: Original cutscene floor strike and complete 7.5-second continuation from the matching next-cut boundary. Original actor and independent prop timing/rotation retained. Native proportions, idle fingers, grounded soles, per-native-mesh shaft/floor calibration and bounded two-bone arm clearance adapt the supplied motion. Modded spear-class weapons use the crafted-spear fallback. No invented motion samples, textures, sound or models.

selection.basis: Original Kiwami Lau Ka Long floor strike and flourish, main12_s04 cuts 007 and 008. The matching boundary pose is included once, followed by 225 original continuation frames, extending playback by exactly 7.5 seconds.

nativeProfiles.basis: All native SubCategory=Spear weapons, including forged, short, fire-hardened, bone, plunger and indexed sprites. Each native mesh gets its own floor/shaft calibration. Unknown modded spear-class weapons use the crafted-spear fallback.
